test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required’.**

**(Because he has been in custody from last July,)** Pickard will now be released in four months.

options.text: Because he had been in custody from last July,
Because he had been under custody from last July,
Because he has been in custody since last July,

solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"Because he has been in custody since last July,"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"from last July"** of the sentence.
 
• **"From" **can sometimes be ambiguous, and using **"since"** makes the temporal relationship more explicit in this case.
 
• The reason to use **"since"** in the blank is to indicate the starting point of the period during which Pickard has been in custody.
 
• **"Since last July"** specifies the beginning of this timeframe, making it clear that his custody has been ongoing since that particular point in time.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Because he has been in custody **since**__ last July, Pickard will now be released in four months. *
